question: Who among the following was appointed as the Chief Minister of Punjab in September 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Charanjit Singh Channi.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

Key Points__**

__
 
• Fifteen__ Punjab Congress MLAs took oath as Ministers in Chief Minister Charanjit Singh Channi’s new Cabinet on 26 September 2021.
 
• Punjab Governor Banwarilal Purohit administered them the oath of office and secrecy at Punjab Raj Bhavan in Chandigarh.
 
• Deputy Chief Ministers Sukhjinder Singh Randhawa and OP Soni had already been sworn in earlier.
 
• After the recent state elections in Punjab in which the Aam Aadmi Party won 92 of the 117 assembly seats, **Bhagwant Mann** took oath as the new Chief Minister of Punjab on **16 March 2022.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

__
